name: mysql-8.0.17-subqueries
query:
SELECT c.email, s.spent,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id, sum(total) AS spent
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) s ON s.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.country = 'JP'
  AND s.spent > (SELECT avg(total) * 12 FROM orders)

outputs.tree:
-> Nested loop inner join
    -> Index lookup on c using customers_country_idx (country='JP')
    -> Filter: (s.spent > (select #4))
        -> Index lookup on s using <auto_key1> (customer_id=c.id)
            -> Materialize
                -> Group aggregate: sum(orders.total)
                    -> Index scan on orders using orders_customer_id_idx
        -> Select #4 (subquery in condition; run only once)
            -> Aggregate: avg(orders.total)
                -> Table scan on orders
-> Select #2 (subquery in projection; dependent)
    -> Aggregate: count(0)
        -> Index lookup on o2 using orders_customer_id_idx (customer_id=c.id)
